1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node of the plurality is configured to transmit to a second node of the plurality at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the plurality of nodes is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to at least one other node of the plurality, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia __received from another node of the plurality__.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on __a minimum desired throughput threshold for each particular node, wherein each node compares its actual throughput against the minimum desired throughput threshold and generates the indicia based on such comparison__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on __a ratio of: (i) an indicia of inter-node interference of the first node, to (ii) an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node__.

5. (Original)

13. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a first node adapted to communicate wirelessly with a first access point, the first node configured to calculate an access attempt percentage for communications with the first access point, wherein the calculation is based at least partially on __a received indicia of inter-node interference between the first node and a second node, wherein the indicia is indicative of transmission success or failure between the second node and its associated access point__.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a dynamic weight value associated with the second node__ to the first node.

15. (Original)

16. (Original)

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and __the first node's transmissions interfere with communication between the second node and the second access point, such that the first node receives indicia of such interference from the second node or the second access point__.

18. (Original)

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using __a wireless protocol compliant with I.E.E.E. 802.11 standards__.

20. (Original)
